title: Supply Under-supplied leaves out a part once its tracking is turned off
custom_preconds:
• Signed in as Admin at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • A tracked part below its Min with one bin (for example 1 on hand, Min 5 / Max 15).
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number and look at Total Qty.
  2. Set Supply to Under-supplied.
  3. Open the part, switch Track quantities and cost of goods OFF, Save.
  4. Keep Supply on Under-supplied.
  5. Set Supply to All.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Total Qty shows "1 available" in the low (red) colour.

Step 2:

  • The part is listed.

Step 3:

  • No prompt; the row shows Not Tracked without a reload, bin chip {bin} | 1, Min 5 / Max 15 kept in their columns.

Step 4:

  • The part is not listed.

Step 5:

  • The part is listed again.
